title: Polytopes and posets associated to preorders
summary: Preorder polytopes, defined from preorders on finite sets, are introduced and studied from a lattice point enumeration point of view. They naturally generalize arbor polytopes, recently introduced and studied by the second named author. Preorder polytopes are shown to be lattice polytopes which satisfy a certain duality relating their Ehrhart polynomials with the zeta polynomials of their posets of lattice points.
